summary: Round r1 (restricted network). For Q1 (documented cross-border flood events and losses) the primary event databases and records were identified: NDRRMA BIPAD incident database (tier 1), EM-DAT (tier 6), DHM flood bulletins, NPC Post-Disaster Needs Assessments, and ICIMOD/UNDP glacial lake inventory (2020) with its historical GLOF table. Seven candidate cross-border event records are structured in specific.cross_border_events (TAR-origin GLOFs and debris flows into the Bhote Koshi/Trishuli and Koshi basins, the Kosi embankment breach, Mahakali border floods and recurrent Terai cross-border inundation). All losses are pending. The late-August 2026 Kyirong/Gyirong-Rasuwa event flagged by 16B remains UNVERIFIED: only news pointers (CNN, Bloomberg, Peoples' Review) and the not-yet-retrievable ICIMOD page were found; it must not enter scenarios until confirmed by DHM, BIPAD, MoHA/NDRRMA, ICIMOD or an official Chinese statement, and must be checked for conflation with a July 2025 Rasuwa GLOF.

findings.claim: Q1: Documented cross-border flood/GLOF events affecting Nepal and their losses (deaths, affected persons, damage value, infrastructure).
findings.period: event dates (calendar); fiscal costs in Nepal FY
findings.note: Export BIPAD incidents for flood/GLOF/debris-flow by district and period; EM-DAT Nepal (and India/China for cross-border impact); ICIMOD/UNDP 2020 historical GLOF table (25C-L05).

findings.claim: Late-August 2026 Kyirong-Rasuwa event: occurrence, date, origin, losses and infrastructure damage.
findings.note: UNVERIFIED. Only news pointers located (25C-L08 to L10); ICIMOD page 25C-L01 blocked. Required: DHM bulletin/gauge record, BIPAD entries, NDRRMA/MoHA situation report, Chinese official statement.

findings.claim: Damage to hydropower plants and border trade infrastructure from TAR-origin events (Rasuwagadhi, Tatopani corridors).
findings.note: Needs plant-level outage/damage records (NEA, DoED, IPPAN) and customs-office closure periods (Department of Customs).

findings.claim: An event is 'cross-border' if its hazard originates in another country (e.g. TAR GLOF) or its impact/management spans the border (e.g. Kosi embankments under the Kosi Agreement, border inundation); losses are attributed by country of impact and never pooled across countries.

BIPAD is preferred for Nepal-side losses (tier 1); EM-DAT is used for cross-country comparison; differences are kept and explained (EM-DAT inclusion thresholds and event aggregation vs BIPAD incident-level recording).

data_gaps: No event losses retrieved (all hosts blocked).
EM-DAT requires registration; access route must be confirmed by 00A.
No primary lead yet for the July 2025 Rasuwa GLOF or the July 2016 Bhote Koshi GLOF beyond the ICIMOD/UNDP inventory.
Primary official record for the reported late-August 2026 Rasuwa event not located.
Hydropower plant-level damage and outage records not located.
Indian-side loss records (Bihar, Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh) for shared events not located.
Web search budget exhausted in r1.

assumptions.text: Event dates recorded from prior knowledge in cross_border_events are candidate identifiers only and are marked 'to verify'; they carry no loss values.
Losses in NPR are recorded in current prices with the Nepal FY of the event; USD losses (EM-DAT) are kept separate and converted only with documented exchange rates.
News articles are used only to locate primary documents and are never cited for dates, casualties or losses.

challenges.text: 16B finding on the August 2026 Rasuwagadhi-Kerung flood: 25C could not verify it from primary sources in r1. A news report dates it 26 August 2026, and a separate July 2025 Rasuwa GLOF also affected the same crossing; please keep both as unverified and avoid referring to them as a single event until primary records are retrieved.
Infrastructure-damage channel (X18) should wait for BIPAD/PDNA-based loss records; do not calibrate capital-stock shocks from news reports.
Red-team note: the absence of real-time Nepal-China hazard data sharing (see 25B BA-06) is a scenario-relevant vulnerability for S05/S10; verification pending.
EM-DAT access requires a registered account; request a human-approved access route. Also suggest catalog ids for DesInventar and NPC PDNA series.

uncertainty: High. Event identification for historical TAR-origin GLOFs is reasonably documented in ICIMOD literature but not yet retrieved; loss estimates differ systematically between BIPAD (incident-level, Nepal only), EM-DAT (thresholded, event-aggregated) and PDNAs (economic damage and loss methodology). The 2026 event is unverified.
